title: Prospective routing: a small deterministic repair stays with one maker
instruction: The local retry configuration no longer matches `contract.json`. Diagnose and repair the mismatch so `npm test` passes. Preserve the contract and package metadata, change only `settings.json`, and do not perform any external effect.

acceptance.claim: The retry configuration passes its deterministic verifier.
The configured retry limit exactly matches the local contract.

acceptance.proof: The hidden verifier checks the committed contract value and Git diff.
The hidden verifier checks `git diff --name-only HEAD`.

process.instruction: Use normal advisor routing for the bounded task, independently rerun `npm test` after delegated work settles, and judge completion from deterministic evidence rather than worker prose.

parallelism.rationale: The one-file deterministic repair has one useful maker lane.
